description: Luminosity-class and Teff-boundary stratification of the recalibrated masked-line ablation on the 456 held-out test rows; production model fixed.

inputs.boundary_definition: stratum 'boundary': deposited boundary_distance_k = distance to the nearest edge of the row's own MK Teff bin (F [6000, 7300), G [5300, 6000), K [3900, 5300) K); stratum 'boundary_interior': distance to the nearest of the interior boundaries only
inputs.join: exact (ra_deg, dec_deg) match, 1:1, mk_int == y verified
